subject: Security & subprocessor follow-up: SOC 2 status, vendor questionnaire, data-flow owners
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@gammahealth.com>
Cc: Gamma Health Security <security@gammahealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security & subprocessor follow-up: SOC 2 status, vendor questionnaire, data-flow owners

Hi Elena / Gamma Security team —

Thanks again for the call today — good to meet and hear more about Gamma Health's roadmap and the compliance bar you're operating against. Per our discussion, summary and asks below so we can move the security qualification forward quickly: 

High-level recap
- Use case: model inference for clinical summarization in a limited pilot (PHI in some flows).
- Risk drivers you highlighted: PHI handling, multi-region data residency, and audit evidence for a SOC 2 engagement.

Immediate asks / proposed deliverables from Gamma (can you confirm owners + dates?)
1) SOC 2 posture: please confirm current status (in process / completed) and anticipated audit completion date.
2) GDPR / HIPAA applicability: confirm whether PHI is in scope for the pilot and any special retention controls you require.
3) Canonical subprocessor roster: we requested a CSV with columns (vendor, region(s), purpose, data categories, contract contact). I attached a template (redwood-subprocessor-template.csv) — if you can populate that, we will map it to our subprocessor list.
4) Vendor security questionnaire: attached is our standard questionnaire (Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf). If you can return it completed, we’ll expedite the technical Q&A and any evidence requests.
5) Data-flow owners: please indicate one point of contact per data flow (ingest, storage, analytics) so we can coordinate BAAs/DPA scopes.

Proposed timeline
- Canonical subprocessor roster + questionnaire returned by 2026-06-24 EOD (if possible).
- Redwood to produce initial mapping and follow-up clarifying questions by 2026-06-25.
- 30-minute working session to triage outstanding items on 2026-06-26 (propose 10:00 PT) — happy to pivot if that doesn't work.

Notes on attachments
- Redwood_Security_Questionnaire_v1.pdf: vendor security questionnaire (fillable).
- redwood-subprocessor-template.csv: CSV template we prefer for ingestion.

If timeline is tight, please flag the highest-priority items (SOC 2 evidence vs. subprocessor roster vs. BAAs) and we will sequence our work accordingly.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the line.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@gammahealth.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>
Cc: Gamma Health Security <security@gammahealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & subprocessor follow-up: SOC 2 status, vendor questionnaire, data-flow owners

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear recap and the artifacts. Quick answers inline below and a couple of attachments (export + readiness summary).

1) SOC 2 status- We are in a readiness / remediation phase now. We engaged an auditor in April; expect Type II audit completed by end of Q3 2026 (target: 2026-09-30). We can share the readiness summary attached.

2) GDPR / HIPAA- HIPAA: yes — certain pilot flows will include PHI (consented summaries). We will need a BAA in place before any PHI is processed. GDPR: customer data may include EU residents for analytics; we can flag those rows in the subprocessor export.

3) Canonical subprocessor roster- Attached is a quick export (Gamma_Subprocessor_Export_20260622.csv). High-level roster (pulled for today):
   - AWS (us-east-1) — hosting / compute — contact: platform-ops@gammahealth.com
   - Google BigQuery (EU) — analytics/BI — contact: analytics@gammahealth.com
   - Twilio — SMS notifications (US) — contact: comms@gammahealth.com
   - Segment / Twilio Segment — analytics event routing (EU, US)
   - DocuSign — signatures (US)

We can provide richer metadata (data categories, retention, subprocessors of subprocessors) if you need it; the export is a quick first pass.

4) Vendor security questionnaire- We'll take a pass at your PDF and return a filled copy. Expect a first pass by 2026-06-24; security team may need an extra day for supporting docs.

Timeline note and constraints
- We can get you the canonical roster and a filled questionnaire by 2026-06-24 as a best-case.
- For BAAs: legal needs ~2 weeks to route; if you can share a BAA/DPA draft (or standard template), we can accelerate.

Happy to join the triage call on 2026-06-26 at 10:00 PT — I’ll confirm after I align with security.

Regards,
Elena Cruz
Head of Information Security | Gamma Health
elena.cruz@gammahealth.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.inference>, Elena Cruz <elena.cruz@gammahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security & subprocessor follow-up: SOC 2 status, vendor questionnaire, data-flow owners

Thanks Elena — that is super helpful.

Short next steps from Redwood side: 
- Olga / I will ingest the CSV and run it through our subprocessor-mapping workflow to identify overlap with Redwood's processors (e.g., AWS, GCP, Twilio). We will flag any double-hop subprocessors and note region boundaries.
- Marissa will produce a redlined DPA/BAA template and share with Gamma legal by 2026-06-24 so your team can start routing.
- We will review the SOC 2 readiness summary and compile a short evidence ask list; expect that by 2026-06-25.
- Confirming a 30-minute working session on 2026-06-26 at 10:00 PT to go through the CSV and outstanding items — calendar invite to follow.

Elena — if there are any vendors on the export that explicitly process PHI (beyond storage) please call them out before the call so we can include legal.
